capabilities: display a floating outline panel of the current note's headings
navigate to sections by clicking headings
highlight the heading currently in the viewport
filter headings by minimum and maximum level
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the plugins folder); no community plugin store install described. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in outline requires opening a fixed panel, and there is no always-visible, floating outline that highlights which heading is currently in view.
summary: Floating sidebar panel that shows an outline of the current note's headings, with collapsible levels and highlighting synced to the viewport scroll position.
